class Counter:
    def __init__(self, tag):
        self.tag = tag
        self.n = 0

    def tick(self):
        self.n = self.n + 1
        print(self.tag, self.n)

a = Counter('red')
b = Counter('blue')
a.tick()
b.tick()
a.tick()

name.en: The counter of a reached 2

tests.code: assert a.n == 2, 'expected: 2 | actual: %r' % (a.n,)

name.ar: عداد b ما زال 1 — استقلال الحالة
name.en: The counter of b stayed at 1 — independent state

tests.code: assert b.n == 1, 'expected: 1 | actual: %r' % (b.n,)

class Team:
    def __init__(self, nam):
        self.name = nam
        self.players = list()

    def add_player(self, player):
        self.players.append(player)

    def describe(self):
        print('team: %s' % self.name)
        print('players: %d' % len(self.players))

red = Team('red')
red.add_player('ana')
blue = Team('blue')
blue.add_player('bo')
red.describe()
blue.describe()

name.en: Both teams described themselves

tests.code: assert 'team: red' in __learner_output__ and 'team: blue' in __learner_output__, 'expected: team: red / team: blue | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

name.ar: كل فريق يرى لاعبه وحده: players: 1 مرتين
name.en: Each team sees only its own player: players: 1 twice

tests.code: assert __learner_output__.count('players: 1') == 2, 'expected: players: 1 twice | actual: %r' % __learner_output__

name.ar: لا تسرب: لا players: 2 في الخرج
name.en: No leak: no players: 2 in the output

tests.code: assert 'players: 2' not in __learner_output__, 'expected: no leaked count | actual: %r' % __learner_output__
